predicted_class_derivation.class_name_lookup: Map the predicted class ID through the established class mapping.
predicted_class_derivation.meaning: The predicted class ID is the zero-based index of the largest value in the ensemble probability vector.
predicted_class_derivation.tie_behavior: Use the first maximum index under standard NumPy argmax semantics unless the serving implementation explicitly defines a different tie policy.

probability_semantics.description: The values are uncalibrated weighted ensemble probabilities. They must not be presented as calibrated confidence scores or as guaranteed probabilities of correctness.
